phenotype: Spatial EcoTyper (https://github.com/digitalcytometry/SpatialEcoTyper) was inspected for a phenotype -> hex mapping on 2026-05-12.
The repo's R/HeatmapView.R is a generic ComplexHeatmap wrapper with no phenotype-name palette; getColors() lives in docs/man only and is not the lab visual language for HEXIF's nine phenotypes.

Falling back to a hand-curated 10-color palette drawn primarily from the Wong color-blind-safe set (https://www.nature.com/articles/nmeth.1618) plus colorcet glasbey_bw_minc_20-style anchors, with phenotype-name assignment hand-tuned so semantically related calls (CD8 T-cell vs the broader CD45+ immune class; M2-like vs the parent macrophage class) sit in adjacent hue families; the rare-immune classes get the most saturated entries (so they stand out at low zoom over an H&E base).
no_call is neutral grey #cccccc per spec section 7.
_provenance.marker_prob_viridis: Matplotlib viridis sampled at t=0.0/0.25/0.5/0.75/1.0; perceptually uniform, colorblind-safe.
_provenance.marker_error_diverging: RdBu_r (cmocean balance), zero=white, +error=red, -error=blue per spec section 7.
